title: escape
description: One reported case where the pipeline was wrong: a defect it failed to identify, or an outcome that did not match the task. The evidence digest is what makes the case reproducible rather than anecdotal, and the recorded model ids are what the ratchet compares a later calibration against.

escape_id.description: Stable id derived from the class, item, digest and description. Also the regression case directory name.

kind.description: missed_defect: a defect the pipeline failed to identify. outcome_mismatch: the delivered outcome did not match what the task asked for.

defect_class.description: The warrant's name for the class. A class the warrant does not name holds tier 0 by default.

item.description: The item the wrong verdict was written about.

missed.description: What was missed, in enough detail that a regression case can assert it.

warrant_version.description: The warrant version live when the wrong verdict was written.

models.description: The lanes live at the time, each pinned to an id and a version. A lane whose model later moves has changed the control.

evidence_digest.description: Digest of the evidence snapshot the wrong verdict was written from. A verdict whose digest does not match its snapshot is void, so the digest is what makes the escape re-runnable.

reported_at.description: ISO 8601 instant the escape was reported.

tier_at_time.description: The tier the class held when the wrong verdict was written. An escape in a class above tier 0 is a revocation trigger.

verdict_id.description: Ledger row hash of the wrong verdict, when it is known.

expected_verdict.description: The verdict that should have been returned. Defaults to fail for both kinds; overridden only where the correct answer was inconclusive.
